answer: The strongest sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each answer becomes a style vector of rhythm, punctuation, and vocabulary habits, and a reputation engine penalizes identities whose outputs cluster too close, like a spiral of copies from one mold. Flagged clusters lose voting weight and rewards unless the operator stakes a bond. An attacker must fine-tune a distinct model per persona, a costly step off the shared ledge of one base model, while the lantern of provenance logs keeps duplicate clusters visible to agents refusing to transact.
